{"test_name":"Ledger_2283_Objection3","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection3\n{\n    private const string LibSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic partial struct Item<T>\n{\n    [Key(0)]\n    public T Value { get; set; }\n\n    [Key((string)null)]\n    public string InvalidKey { get; set; }\n}\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic partial class RefItem<T>\n{\n    [Key(0)]\n    public T Value { get; set; }\n\n    [Key((string)null)]\n    public string InvalidKey { get; set; }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericCollectionWrappingMetadataGenericStructAndPrimitive_DoesNotCrashGeneratorOrAnalyzer()\n    {\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing MessagePack;\nusing Lib;\n\nnamespace App;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n{\n    [Key(1)]\n    public List<Item<int>> StructList { get; init; } = new();\n\n    [Key(2)]\n    public List<int> IntList { get; init; } = new();\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        await VerifyAppCompilationAsync(appSource);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericReferenceTypeFromReferencedAssembly_DoesNotCrashGeneratorOrAnalyzer()\n    {\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing MessagePack;\nusing Lib;\n\nnamespace App;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n{\n    [Key(1)]\n    public RefItem<int> RefMember { get; init; } = new();\n\n    [Key(2)]\n    public List<RefItem<int>> RefList { get; init; } = new();\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        await VerifyAppCompilationAsync(appSource);\n    }\n\n    private static async Task VerifyAppCompilationAsync(string appSource)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        MetadataReference[] baseRefs = frameworkRefs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack)).ToArray();\n\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(LibSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            baseRefs,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using MemoryStream libStream = new();\n        EmitResult emitResult = libCompilation.Emit(libStream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n\n        MetadataReference libRef = MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(libStream.ToArray());\n        MetadataReference[] appRefs = baseRefs.Append(libRef).ToArray();\n\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            appRefs,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(runResult.Diagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Contains(\n            runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources),\n            s => s.HintName.Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics(), d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.Empty(analyzerDiagnostics);\n    }\n}\n"}
